caption:
After sitting all day, Mr Turtle feels a twinge at the front of the knee the moment he stands.

Standing up with your feet out in front and your body upright asks the knees to do most of the work. Sit near the front of the chair, bring your feet slightly back and lean until your nose is over your knees, so the hips can share the load. Practise standing and sitting slowly, 10 reps, twice a day. Using your hands or a higher chair at first is fine.

A swollen or warm knee, catching or giving way, or no change after two weeks are worth an assessment. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help. Book online via the link in bio
